summary: Describes check mode as a simulation that won't produce output for tasks with conditionals based on registered results, but is good for validating config-management playbooks. Run it with `ansible-playbook foo.yml --check`.
questions: How do I do a dry run of a playbook?
Why do some tasks show nothing in check mode?
Is check mode reliable when tasks depend on registered variables?

answer_card.title: Run a playbook in check mode
answer_card.answer_md:
```console
ansible-playbook foo.yml --check
```
Check mode is only a simulation. Tasks that use conditionals based on registered variables (results of earlier tasks) won't produce output. It works well for validating configuration-management playbooks that run on one node at a time.
